description: City of Sydney Bus shelters is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. This data is provided by the City of Sydney and provides bus shelter locations. There are 40 public bus shelters controlled by the City of Sydney. The API provides data in GeoJSON format, for more information visit City of Sydney. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are City of Sydney, bus, council, open data, public. It offers 1 resource(s) in JSON. The portal shows 2025-06-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
